newsitem.title: UK: BT says no Concert deal in Portugal yet.
newsitem.headline: BT says no Concert deal in Portugal yet.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc said on Wednesday that it was keen to sell its Concert Communication Services in Portugal but added no deal had yet been signed with Portugal Telecom.
"BT is interested in distributing Concert in Portugal but no agreement has been signed to date," a company spokesman told Reuters.
Portugal's Capital newspaper reported earlier that Portugal Telecom had opted for Concert, BT's joint venture with U.S. carrier MCI Communications Corp to provide global services to business clients.
Quoting sources close to negotiations, the newspaper said Concert had been chosen because it was best-placed globally.
Concert's rivals are Global One, a partnership between America's Sprint Corp, Deutsche Telekom and France Telecom and the Unisource/Uniworld alliance led by AT&T.
